node.statement: Original corner geometry. Write e_U=sum_{j in U}e_j, e_V=sum_{j in V}e_j, and e_R=e_U+e_V in C^m. Because U,V are disjoint and nonempty, e_U,e_V,e_R are nonzero self-adjoint norm-one projections, e_U e_R=e_R e_U=e_U and likewise for V. By def-maincb-partition-state and linearity, w(e_W)=P_W for W=U,V,R and P_R=P_U+P_V. At level one, the extended t-inclusion clause of def-extended-delta-inclusion therefore makes P_U,P_V,P_R t-projections and gives all four subordination estimates ||P_U P_R-P_U||,||P_R P_U-P_U||,||P_V P_R-P_V||,||P_R P_V-P_V||<=t. Its lower norm bound gives ||P_R||>=1-t, so for t<=1/2 P_R satisfies the nonvanishing alternative in def-delta-projection. Since epsilon_A<=t, every epsilon_A-C*-axiom bound weakens to the corresponding t-bound, so A is an extended t-C*-algebra. Thus all geometric hypotheses of lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison and lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer are established, rather than assumed.
